note: Living record for the #1069 dimension classification (epic #1070, F1 #1423). The plan doc's markdown table is the 2026-10-22 snapshot and is NOT rewritten; this registry supersedes it as the living source. Statuses were seeded 2026-10-25 against main 4bb1ba5 (S2 matrix #1422, lanes #1517/#1523) and must be re-verified against main on every edit. Core rule: a dimension is never 'supported' because an interface or config field exists; supported means a verification reference resolves to a test that passes (see tests/dimension_registry.test.ts). Phase S exit criteria: the §1/§8 dimensions are not marked 'supported' until S1 is enforced (not just observing) AND the S2 matrix is green.
